title: Naruto's dream
content: Naruto Uzumaki wants to become Hokage, the leader of his village, so that the villagers who shunned him will finally acknowledge him.
evidence_quote: Despite this, he aspires to become his village's leader, the Hokage, to receive their approval.

title: The Nine-Tailed Fox inside Naruto
content: The Nine-Tailed Fox was sealed inside Naruto when he was a newborn, which is why many villagers feared and avoided him as a child.

title: Who created Naruto
content: Naruto was written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto and serialized in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump from 1999 to 2014.
evidence_quote: Written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto, Naruto was serialized for a 15-year run in Shueisha's magazine, Weekly Shōnen Jump from September 21, 1999, to November 10, 2014.

title: Kakashi leads Team 7
content: Kakashi Hatake is the leader of Team 7, the squad made up of Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno.
evidence_quote: Kakashi Hatake is introduced as the Jonin (elite ninja) leader in charge of Team 7, a new ninja team including Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno.

title: Sasuke's early goal
content: Early in the series, Sasuke Uchiha's main goal is to grow strong enough to take revenge on his older brother Itachi, who wiped out their clan.
evidence_quote: Sasuke's feelings of powerlessness force him to abandon his friends and his home in his quest to become stronger than Itachi, and to find Orochimaru.
notes: auto-verified: evidence quote matched source text

title: The truth behind the Uchiha massacre
content: Itachi Uchiha killed his clan on the orders of Konoha's leadership to stop a planned coup, and spared his younger brother Sasuke because he loved him.

title: Naruto's father
content: Naruto's father is Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage, who sealed the Nine-Tailed Fox inside his own son.
evidence_quote: Naruto is an orphan who has a dangerous fox-like entity known as Kurama the Nine-Tailed Fox sealed within his body by his father, the Fourth Hokage Minato Namikaze, the leader of the Hidden Leaf Village, at the cost of his own life
notes: auto-verified: evidence quote matched source text

title: Naruto becomes Hokage
content: In the sequel Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, Naruto has achieved his dream and serves as the Seventh Hokage.
